newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S MALEV PAYS NO DIVIDEND ON 1996 - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S MALEV PAYS NO DIVIDEND ON 1996 - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: Hungary's national airline Malev Rt will not pay a dividend after its shareholders' decision despite the fact that it almost doubled its after-tax profit in 1996 over 1995, daily Magyar Hirlap said on Saturday.
In 1996 Malev boosted its after-tax profit to 346 million forints from 186 million forints in 1995, it said, adding that its turnover rose 26 percent to 55.67 billion forints.
Last year almost 1.9 million passangers flew, 19.2 percent more than in 1995, on Malev board, with 1.56 million on scheduled flights and 320,000 on charter flights.

Malev is 30 percent owned by Italy's Alitalia , the Italian investment fund Simest holds five percent and employees also have an around five percent stake. The remaining shares are held by the state privatisation agency APV Rt.
